narrative.overview:
Settee is the British front room at night: the good settee, the lamps low, the telly on. The room is dark and warm, nearly black with plum in it, so the picture and the artwork are the brightest things in it. One coral light, the Highlight, always shows where the remote is. Everything else steps back. The type is a soft, old-fashioned serif for names and a friendly humanist sans for everything you read, both big enough to read from across the room.

There are two densities in the same room. Live TV, the guide and Home are quiet, dense and quick: rows, rules and small cards, nothing ornamental. Movies, Shows and details pages are where the room opens up: big backdrops, portrait covers, space around the title. Calm is how it looks, never how fast it goes. No transition makes the viewer wait to press the next button, and anything that can't hold 60 fps on a Fire TV Stick doesn't move at all.

It must never look like a sideloaded IPTV box, a stretched phone app or a storefront: no neon, no grid of glossy tiles, no promotional hero, no badges shouting for attention.
keyCharacteristics: Always dark, one set of colours, no light theme.
One accent, coral, which means "the remote is here", with a red kept only for recording.
Flat, solid surfaces layered by tone. No blur, no see-through shades, at most one glow.
Young Serif for names and headings, Alegreya Sans for reading, nothing under 16 sp.
Every question opens in a Side Panel down the right, never a dialog in the middle.
Two Highlight treatments: a ring and lift on artwork, a solid coral fill on everything list-like.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Coral marks where the remote is, or what's chosen. Never use it to decorate, for a badge, or to draw the eye to something the viewer can't press. On a TV, coral reads as "press me".

rules.name: The Tally Light Rule
rules.body: Tally Red means recording now. Failures, series links and clashes are never red.

rules.name: The Solid Colour Rule
rules.body: Things step back by colour, never by opacity. Watched episodes use Mushroom, not see-through Cream, and shelves are never dimmed. The only see-through colours are the fades and dark pills that keep text readable over artwork.

rules.name: The Sofa Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is smaller than 16 sp. A test on the type tokens checks it.

rules.name: The Lined-Up Figures Rule
rules.body: Every role draws lining, tabular figures (`lnum, tnum`), so times, counts and episode numbers line up down the guide and the lists.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Young Serif only has Regular. Never ask it for bold; hierarchy in headings comes from size.

rules.name: The Press Budget Rule
rules.body: A layout is judged by the presses it costs. Daily routes have limits in `docs/LOOK.md` (one press to the first Continue Watching card, none to the next episode), and a new layout mustn't exceed them.

rules.name: The Remembered Place Rule
rules.body: Coming back into a row lands on the card the viewer was last on there, never on whatever is at the same position.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Never more than one glow on screen, and never blur, a dimmed shade behind a panel, or two screens drawn see-through at once. The Side Panel sits solid over the screen with nothing dimmed behind it.

rules.name: The Solid Floor Rule
rules.body: Every screen draws a solid background. Only where video plays (the players, the Live Preview) is the area left clear for the picture.

dos: Do build from `ui/design` and Compose foundation: `HighlightSurface`, `PillButton`, `Pill`, `ListRow`, `ArtCard`, `SidePanel`, `ScreenFrame`, `AerialTv`, `ErrorMessage`.
Do make every new element reachable and obvious with a D-pad. If it can take the Highlight, it draws one of the two treatments: ring and lift on artwork, solid coral fill on everything else.
Do switch text and icons to Plum Ink on anything coral, including a switch's track and the small aerial TV.
Do keep text 16 sp or larger, with lining, tabular figures.
Do put the fade under any text that sits on artwork, and make it follow the text, not the art: at least 0.7 of Aubergine Dusk under words and 0.9 under quiet text.
Do put every question, choice, confirmation and notice in a Side Panel.
Do check any motion on a Fire TV Stick: under 16.7 ms a frame while it moves, or it doesn't move.
donts: Don't use Material 3 or `RoundedCornerShape` outside `ui/design` (detekt bans it). Use `SetteeShapes`.
Don't use coral for decoration, badges or anything that can't be pressed (The One Lamp Rule).
Don't use red for anything but recording now (The Tally Light Rule).
Don't blur, dim behind a panel, use more than one glow, or draw two screens see-through at once (The One Glow Rule).
Don't step things back with opacity; use Mushroom (The Solid Colour Rule).
Don't add a light theme, a dialog in the middle of the screen, or a promotional hero on Home.
Don't fake a bold in Young Serif.
Don't make the viewer wait for a transition. Screen changes dip through the background in about 300 ms, and presses during it still go through.
Don't let it look like a sideloaded IPTV box, a stretched phone app or a storefront.
